_A_INPUT_FILE_COMPONENT_DESCRIPTION_: The AInputFile component chooses files with a button or a dropzone, checks the type, the size and the number of the files, shows them in a list and shows the upload status of every file. The upload itself is done by your application.
_A_INPUT_FILE_ACCESSIBILITY_DESCRIPTION_: Accessibility: the real file input is focusable, its name is the label and the text of the button, the hint with the allowed files is connected with aria-describedby. Added, removed and rejected files are announced (aria-live). Every file has a remove button with the file name, after removing the focus moves to the next file or to the input. The dropzone is an addition for the mouse, everything works with the keyboard as well.
_A_INPUT_FILE_EXAMPLE_SERVER_ERROR_: The server did not accept the file
_A_INPUT_FILE_EXAMPLE_HELP_TEXT_: Scan all pages into one file
_A_INPUT_FILE_GROUP_BASIC_DESCRIPTION_: The model is an object with name, size, type and file. The list shows the name and the size; a file can be removed.
_A_INPUT_FILE_GROUP_MULTIPLE_DESCRIPTION: With is-multiple the model is an array. A new choice replaces the files; with is-append the files are added to the list.
_A_INPUT_FILE_GROUP_DROPZONE_DESCRIPTION: is-dropzone shows an area for dragging and dropping files. It is highlighted while files are dragged over it; the link in it opens the file dialog.
_A_INPUT_FILE_GROUP_RESTRICTIONS_DESCRIP: accept (extensions and MIME types), max-size (bytes) and max-files are checked for chosen and for dropped files. They are shown as a hint (accept-text replaces the list of types). Files that are not added are listed with the reason and emitted with the event reject.
_A_INPUT_FILE_GROUP_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION_: is-preview shows a small preview of images instead of the file icon.
_A_INPUT_FILE_GROUP_UPLOAD_DESCRIPTION_: Set progress (0–100), status (uploading, success, error) and errorText in the items of the model, the list shows them. The example simulates the upload; a file with «error» in the name fails.
_A_INPUT_FILE_GROUP_LINKS_DESCRIPTION_: Files from the server need only name, size and url: the name becomes a link. is-removable hides the remove buttons, readonly shows only the list.
_A_INPUT_FILE_GROUP_HELP_TEXT_DESCRIPTIO: Like all form elements: label-description, help-text, errors and required. text changes the text of the button.
_A_INPUT_FILE_GROUP_FORM_DESCRIPTION_: In AForm the component is used with type: "file".
_A_INPUT_FILE_PROPS_ACCEPT_DESCRIPTION_: Allowed files: extensions (.pdf), MIME types (application/pdf) and MIME groups (image/*), separated by commas. Checked for chosen and dropped files.
_A_INPUT_FILE_PROPS_ACCEPT_TEXT_DESCRIPT: Own text of the allowed files in the hint instead of the list of accept.
_A_INPUT_FILE_PROPS_DROP_TEXT_DESCRIPTIO: Text of the dropzone before the link.
_A_INPUT_FILE_PROPS_IS_APPEND_DESCRIPTIO: With is-multiple: new files are added to the list instead of replacing it.
_A_INPUT_FILE_PROPS_IS_DROPZONE_DESCRIPT: Shows an area for dragging and dropping files.
_A_INPUT_FILE_PROPS_IS_FILE_SIZE_DESCRIP: Shows the size of the files in the list.
_A_INPUT_FILE_PROPS_IS_HINT_DESCRIPTION_: Shows the hint with accept, max-size and max-files.
_A_INPUT_FILE_PROPS_IS_MULTIPLE_DESCRIPT: Several files can be chosen; the model is an array.
_A_INPUT_FILE_PROPS_IS_REMOVABLE_DESCRIP: Shows a remove button for every file.
_A_INPUT_FILE_PROPS_MAX_FILES_DESCRIPTIO: With is-multiple: the maximum number of files.
_A_INPUT_FILE_PROPS_MAX_SIZE_DESCRIPTION: The maximum size of a file in bytes.
_A_INPUT_FILE_PROPS_TEXT_DESCRIPTION_: Text of the button. By default «Choose file» or «Choose files».
_A_INPUT_FILE_EVENTS_REJECT_DESCRIPTION_: Files were not added. Gets { files }, every file with name, file, reason (type, size, count) and text.
_A_INPUT_FILE_EVENTS_REMOVE_DESCRIPTION_: A file was removed. Gets { model, index }.
_A_INPUT_FILE_EVENTS_FOCUS_DESCRIPTION_: The file input gets the focus.
_A_INPUT_FILE_EVENTS_BLUR_DESCRIPTION_: The file input loses the focus.
_A_INPUT_FILE_MODEL_FILE_DESCRIPTION_: The chosen File object (for the upload).
_A_INPUT_FILE_MODEL_URL_DESCRIPTION_: Link to the file: the name becomes a link.
_A_INPUT_FILE_MODEL_DOWNLOAD_DESCRIPTION: The link downloads the file instead of opening it.
_A_INPUT_FILE_MODEL_STATUS_DESCRIPTION_: Upload status: uploading, success or error.
_A_INPUT_FILE_MODEL_PROGRESS_DESCRIPTION: Upload progress 0–100. Without a value while uploading the bar is indeterminate.
